data.title: 久远寺有珠 · 纯白高柱四柱床的冰雪融化独奏 ·「哪怕是童话的终章……也想和你一直在一起」
data.description: 【久远寺主卧四柱大床·深夜】重重帷幔掩映的古典大床。有珠褪去所有魔女的防具，赤裸地躺在厚重的天鹅绒被褥上。手指深陷在湿润滚烫的私处深处抽送，平日里沉静如古井的心跳彻底失控，眼泪静静划过白皙的脸颊——「母亲……童话里的魔女……终于也学会爱一个人了……」
data.location: 久远寺主卧四柱大床·深夜
data.action: 仰卧四柱床帷幔深处全裸自抚，黑发散落枕间，黑眸噙泪动情高潮
data.promptProse: Deep inside the heavy velvet drapes of her antique four-poster bed, Alice Kuonji lies completely naked across the ivory sheets. Stripped of all witchcraft, her fingers pump rhythmically into her soaking, sensitive depths, her arched spine trembling as waves of unfamiliar passion overwhelm her discipline. Her dark bob splays across the pillows, silent tears of profound emotional discovery slipping past her porcelain cheeks as breathless gasps escape her parted lips. Intimate vertical framing, silver moonlight slicing through gothic mullioned windows, detailed Victorian mansion background, solo 1girl, no extra people.
